messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to schedule a 60m security + compliance primer for the inference stack (hosted/dedicated/private). Primary goals: threat modeling for Private deploy, compliance checklist for upcoming customer audits, and an access/IAM review for Dedicated seats. Propose next week Tue/Wed 11:00-12:00 or Thu 15:00-16:00. @jon @ravi any conflicts? Also need someone to own the threat-model pre-read (1 pager + Miro).

jon: Tue 11 is fine for me. Wed I have infra onboarding. Thu afternoon is rough.

ravi: Wed after 10 ok but can’t do Tue morning. Prefer morning if possible.

lara: I can run the threat-model section and prepare a short Miro board. Happy to own the pre-read (will draft a 1-pager).

olivia: I’ll pull the audit checklist + last-quarter findings and bring IAM export (policy dump + recent role changes). Need anyone to ping infra for the IAM CSV?

sam: Suggest agenda draft (short):
```
1) 5m intro / goals (maria)
2) 20m threat model walkthrough (lara)
3) 15m access/IAM findings + mitigation proposals (olivia)
4) 10m compliance checklist & gaps (sam)
5) 10m next steps / owners / timelines
```
Add data residency and KMS integration as separate bullets?

maria: Yep include both @sam. Data residency for Private deployments and KMS/HSM integration for key management are must-discuss items.

lara: Will add Miro link and a 1-page pre-read to the doc. ETA EOD Monday. Anyone who wants to add specific risks please drop them on the Miro.

jon: Should we invite compliance/legal or keep it engineering-only first pass?

olivia: Recommend engineering-only for the first pass. If we see vendor/customer-facing gaps, loop in legal & compliance in the follow-up.

calendarbot: Proposed time created: Tue 11:00-12:00 (1758724301) — 5 invites accepted, 2 tentative. Link: https://company.calendar/event/abc123

maria: Okay locking Tue 11-12 since that works for most. Action items before the meeting:
- lara: threat-model 1-pager + Miro (EOD Mon)
- olivia: IAM export + audit notes (Mon am)
- sam: compliance checklist + owner mapping (Mon)
- jon: quick infra/runbook read — check for deployment-specific configs (Mon)
- maria: send calendar + Zoom + add agenda to thread

ravi: If something blocks Tue morning for me I’ll update here but plan stands.

maria: Thanks all. I’ll post the pre-read links and Zoom in this thread once lara uploads. Try to skim the pre-read before Tue so we can dive into mitigations. :thumbsup:
